description: This file defines a custom implementation of CookieAuthenticationEvents for handling token revocation in an ASP.NET Core web application. It overrides the ValidatePrincipal method to check if a user's authentication should be revoked based on cache entries.

classes.name: RevokeAuthenticationEvents
classes.description: A custom implementation of CookieAuthenticationEvents to revoke user sessions based on cache entries.

methods.name: ValidatePrincipal
methods.description: Overrides the default validation to revoke user sessions if a cache entry indicates revocation.
